pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.2: tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ paṇītānaṃ bhattānaṃ bhattapaṭipāṭi adhiṭṭhitā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.3: athakho aññatarassa daliddassa kammakārassa etadahosi na kho idaṃ orakaṃ bhavissati yathāyime manussā sakkaccaṃ bhattaṃ karonti yannūnāhaṃpi bhattaṃ kareyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.4: athakho so daliddo kammakāro yena kirapatiko tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ kirapatikaṃ etadavoca icchāmahaṃ ayyaputta buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa bhattaṃ kātuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.6: sopi kho kirapatiko saddho hoti pasanno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.7: athakho so kirapatiko tassa daliddassa kammakārassa atirekaṃ vetanaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.8: athakho so daliddo kammakāro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so daliddo kammakāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.9: adhivāsetu me bhante bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.12: bahū me badarā paṭiyattā badaramissakena peyyā paripūressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.14: athakho so daliddo kammakāro bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.15: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū daliddena kira kammakārena svātanāya buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito badaramissakena peyyā paripūressantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.17: assosuṃ kho manussā daliddena kira kammakārena buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantitoti. te daliddassa kammakārassa pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ abhihariṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.18: athakho so daliddo kammakāro tassā rattiyā accayena paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi kālo bhante niṭṭhitaṃ bhattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.19: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena tassa daliddassa kammakārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.20: athakho so daliddo kammakāro bhattagge bhikkhū parivisati. bhikkhū evamāhaṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.21: thokaṃ āvuso dehi thokaṃ āvuso dehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.22: mā kho tumhe bhante ayaṃ daliddo kammakāroti thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭiggaṇhittha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.25: na kho mayaṃ āvuso etaṃkāraṇā thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.26: apica mayaṃ kālasseva piṇḍāya caritvā bhuñjimhā tena mayaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ paṭiggaṇhāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.27: athakho so daliddo kammakāro ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.28: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā mayā nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.30: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa daliddassa kammakārassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.31: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.32: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.33: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.36: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā aññatra nimantitā aññatra bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.37: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.38: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:1.40: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.2: aññataro bhikkhu piṇḍapātaṃ ādāya yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca bhuñjāhi āvusoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.4: tassa bhikkhuno piṇḍapāto ussūre āhariyittha. so bhikkhu na cittarūpaṃ bhuñji.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.6: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā paramparabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.8: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.10: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:2.11: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvaradānasamaye sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyādetvā bhikkhū nimantenti bhojetvā cīvarena acchādessāmāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.2: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā paramparabhojananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.6: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.8: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.9: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.10.1: tena kho pana samayena manussā cīvarakārake bhikkhū bhattena nimantenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.11: bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā nādhivāsenti paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā paramparabhojananti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.16: tatthāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānasamayo cīvarakārasamayo ayaṃ tattha samayoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:3.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.1: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.2: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. athakho te manussā bhagavato ca āyasmato ca ānandassa bhojanaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.7: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave bhattapaccāsaṃ vikappetvā paramparabhojanaṃ bhuñjituṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:4.9: evañca pana bhikkhave vikappetabbaṃ mayhaṃ bhattapaccāsaṃ itthannāmassa dammīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.2: pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññatarena bhojanena nimantito taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ pañcannaṃ bhojanānaṃ aññataraṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati etaṃ paramparabhojanaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.6: na sakkoti ekāsane nisinno yāvadatthaṃ bhuñjituṃ. gilānasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.8: anatthate kaṭhine vassānassa pacchimo māso atthate kaṭhine pañca māsā. cīvaradānasamayoti bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.1.11: aññatra samayā bhuñjissāmīti paṭiggaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.1: paramparabhojane paramparabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.2: paramparabhojane vematiko aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.2.3: paramparabhojane naparamparabhojanasaññī aññatra samayā bhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.6: sakalena gāmena nimantito tasmiṃ gāme yattha katthaci bhuñjati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc33:5.3.7: sakalena pūgena nimantito tasmiṃ pūge yattha katthaci bhuñjati
